🚨An ICE agent hit a U.S. citizen with his car…

A man is walking down a public sidewalk… doing nothing illegal… simply filming.

An ICE agent turns into a gated entrance, and instead of waiting for the man to cross, instead of honking, instead of yielding like literally every driver is required to do…

He drives straight into him.

We have already seen ICE agents kill people when someone moves a car near them…

…but this agent?

BREAKING: Nashville Journalist Estefany Rodriguez Released From ICE Detention  (by Pablo Manríquez). An immigration judge had ordered her release on bond days ago. ICE fought it. She's out anyway.

Tom Homan's Big Ask: Credit for Not Committing Crimes (by Pablo Manríquez). The White House counteroffer on ICE accountability is mostly a restatement of federal law. Renee Good is still dead. The agents who terrorize America are still masked and anonymous.
Meet the Lobbyists Behind Migrant Detention (by Pablo Manríquez). Seventeen thriving private prison industry lobbyists on their way straight to Hell.
